column3: MT 40:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “he stretched out to me” is rendered “He inclined to me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a pit of roaring” is rendered “a horrible pit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “turned to” is rendered “respect,” and “those who fall away to falsehood” “such as turn aside to lies.”
Close to the Hebrew; “none can compare to you” is rendered “Cannot be recounted to You in order.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ears you have dug for me” is rendered “My ears You have opened.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the midst of my inward parts” is rendered “within my heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have announced righteousness” is rendered “I have proclaimed the good news of righteousness.”
Close to the Hebrew; רָעוֹת (“evils, troubles”) is rendered “evils.”
Close to the Hebrew; יָשֹׁמּוּ (“be appalled”) is rendered “be confounded.”
